title: Data and AI governance: Promoting equity, ethics, and fairness in large language models
benchmark_measurement: The paper discusses a framework to measure bias across multiple dimensions, including stereotypes and biases related to religious beliefs.
findings: Biases related to religious beliefs are prevalent in the outputs of large language models. These are part of a broader set of biases spanning dimensions like gender, race, age, and culture.
